description: Match a name, developer, country, region or city across the project trackers and return the matching rows with their capacities, largest first. dataset: renewables (Saudi renewable projects — technology, capacity MW, status operational|construction|tendered|announced, developers, LCOE), captive (Saudi captive and corporate solar: corporate PPAs, plants owned by the factory or farm they supply, plants built into water projects — capacity as the source states it, offtaker, arrangement, status operational|construction|contracted|tendered|announced|observed, sources), gcc (utility-scale solar, CSP, wind and battery projects of 50 MW or more in the UAE, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait and Bahrain — country as ISO code, capacity as stated, procurer, owners and developers, published tariff, the same statuses, sources), regional (the same kind of rows in the Middle East beyond the Gulf, Africa, the Caucasus, Central Asia and South and Southeast Asia — country as ISO code, wind-solar hybrids as technology hybrid, tariffs only in US cents/kWh), world (the same row shape for the flagship projects of every other country — the US, Canada, Latin America, Europe, China, Japan, Korea, Australia and the rest: renewables of 1 GW or more and batteries of 300 MW or 1,000 MWh or more), data-centres (Saudi data-centre records — lead, city, disclosed MW with its basis, investment), ccus (global carbon capture projects — developer, country, capture Mt/yr, sector), hydrogen (the IEA low-emission hydrogen map, mirrored as capacity by year, region and stage rather than as named projects). Omit dataset to search the renewables, captive, GCC, regional, world, data-centre and CCUS trackers at once. Capacity totals are summed only inside one dataset, in that dataset’s own unit; captive, GCC, regional and world capacity is MW as each source states it (MWac or MWp) and heat (MWth) is never added. The renewables, captive, gcc, regional, world and data-centres datasets are free with membership: they answer a request carrying a member’s API key, and refuse one without, as does a search with no dataset named; ccus and hydrogen answer anyone. For every other tracker in the project index (Saudi battery storage, the GCC, Regional and World Data Centre Trackers, the water, AI and dedicated-systems registers), filters by stage, technology or date, and counts or totals, use find_projects and aggregate_projects.

query.description: Name, developer, country, region or city

name: search_projects
title: Search the project trackers
